contract_name: RI#5 Development and Candidate Release Gates

mandatory_rules.requirement: Recover Actual Internal Current and all mandatory projections before implementation; missing or inconsistent binding blocks work.
Test-count PASS alone is not Candidate release evidence and never grants Human Runtime or Production Acceptance.
Run the Current Candidate anti-regression ledger and preserve every accepted baseline, protected concept, UI behavior, contract, and evidence boundary applicable to the changed path.
Verify changed behavior with applicable positive, negative, failure-path, protected-concept, and baseline-differential checks; collection success or test quantity is insufficient.
Build and release a Candidate only through its Canonical packaging and release gate; any mandatory gate failure blocks Candidate release.
Machine verification does not consume Human Runtime Authorization or grant acceptance; required Human Runtime Verification must remain explicit and pending until Human-authorized evidence exists.
Before runtime, prove canonical caller, trigger, endpoint, authentication, input source, target binding, and fresh Human GO; do not invent or substitute a launcher.
Before closure, verify Current Source, exact scope, required derived artifacts, commit identity, predecessor, integrity, push, and remote read-back wherever applicable.

Do not release with unresolved blocking or unknown drift, protected-baseline regression, required validation failure, scope or authority expansion, security/privacy risk, paid-content leakage, or missing Human decision.

source_contracts: Human + ChatGPT to Codex Synchronization Contract
